verdict.rationale: cubic ships agentic features such as one-click 'Fix with cubic' fixes, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it supports multiple parallel attempts. The evidence documents only single fixes pushed directly to the PR branch, with no way to run several attempts and compare them before choosing one. Codebase scans that deploy many agents to find bugs are a different capability and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run several task attempts in parallel and compare results before choosing one
